page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, providing 72 vCPUs. It is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps. The absence of local NVMe storage and GPU resources represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the instance's utility on network-attached storage architectures and CPU-bound workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio position this instance as a stable resource for enterprise applications requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of GPU hardware. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include general-purpose web serving, application servers, distributed enterprise applications, and database deployments utilizing network-attached storage.
